gameClusterBootstrap.assumption: Exploratory held-out game resampling; does not certify future-season stationarity

limitations: Observed shot locations are not pregame features
Historical endpoint revisions are not archived event-time snapshots
No provider high-danger definition or high-danger xG
No 5v5 exposure or per-60 estimate
No shot-volume forecast or pregame score distribution
Reliability bins describe held-out evidence; they do not certify calibration
